items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: A critical zero-day remote code execution vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', was actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could be leveraged by an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. CISA added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on September 24, 2026, due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability addressed in APSB26-92 that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability addressed in APSB26-92 that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B, addressed in APSB26-92, that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability addressed in APSB26-92 that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Improper Access Control (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An improper access control vulnerability, addressed in APSB25-71, that could allow an attacker to bypass security features and reach functionality that should require authorization.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability addressed in APSB26-92 that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: XML External Entity Injection in REST API (CosmicSting)
items.summary: A critical XML external entity injection vulnerability in the REST API, publicly known as 'CosmicSting', allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files and, when chained with another bug, execute code. Adobe noted in its August 11, 2026 bulletin that this vulnerability has been exploited in the wild.
